extras.egress_verbatim: Free, no account, no key. Cloudflare-fronted with permanent per-URL caching on the tag/commit form.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Serves GitHub files at 50 MB where jsDelivr's /gh/ stops at 20 MB — that is the single most useful number here, because it doubles the shard size on an otherwise identical origin. Use rawcdn.githack.com for immutable shards and jsDelivr /gh/ as a second mirror for the smaller ones.
extras.tooling_verbatim: Two URL forms: raw.githack.com/<owner>/<repo>/<branch|tag>/<path> (development, minutes of cache) and rawcdn.githack.com/<owner>/<repo>/<tag|commit>/<path> (production, cached permanently). Plain GET.
extras.agent_focus: CDN / edge platforms as storage+egress: Fastly (free tier + Fast Forward OSS), Akamai/Linode, Bunny.net (storage + free origin->CDN transit), KeyCDN, CacheFly, Gcore, CDN77, StackPath status, Edgio/Limelight status, jsDelivr, unpkg, esm.sh, Statically, raw.githack, ghproxy mirrors. Question asked: which CDN gives free or near-free egress so a cheap origin becomes viable. Cloudflare R2 excluded per brief. Hard-probed every per-file cap with real GETs this session.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
